facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: audit finding - change assurance not applied to LA-7201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on LA-7201 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. LA-7201 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 27 February 2024 a planned assurance activity of LA-7201 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the secondary containment by bund and drainage not effective.
